name: AMA-bench-lcm
description: AMA-bench-lcm is a focused arithmetic benchmark that evaluates a model's ability to compute least common multiples and related integer arithmetic reasoning. It measures exact numeric-answer correctness on generated LCM problems of varying sizes and formats. The benchmark is designed to stress symbolic arithmetic and stepwise calculation abilities of language models.
reputation: A small, niche arithmetic benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption but useful for targeted testing of numeric reasoning.
